items.title: Circular Diamond Cross DXF Lattice for Balanced Modern Screens
items.description: Rounded arcs interlock into a grid of diamonds and crosses, giving a soft yet structured geometric rhythm across the panel. The balanced circular-diamond motif suits modern gates, stair infill, and screens wanting understated elegance.

items.title: Crystalline Diamond Mosaic DXF Panel for Stained-Glass Doors
items.description: Angular shard-like facets crisscross into an X pattern down the panel, resembling shattered stained glass. The dramatic faceted geometry suits statement front doors, gallery screens, and modern stained-glass-inspired dividers.
